revision_5.his_words: The fade out of the cat video is glitchy in terms of the video and audio. We need to be really clever about this. (Krish, 2026-11-09)
causes: video: as the cat panel slid away, the full-frame take underneath showed a second copy of him at another size, then the picture jumped to a third framing
audio: the cat clip's song (about 108 bpm) and Seize It (126 bpm) overlapped in a 2 s crossfade, so the two beats clashed
fix: one continuous matched move in and out: the cat panel and his full-frame picture move together on the same smooth ease (not stepped on twos), so there is only ever one of him

a DJ-style cut, never a blend: the cat song closes on its own strong beat (12.65 s into the clip) with a quick low-pass sweep over that last beat; Seize It starts on one of its own kick hits (29.9 s into the track) at that same instant; the picture move ends on the same beat
checked: at the cut the level falls to about -48 dBFS with no sample jump above 0.003, inside a pause in his speech
revision_5.rule_for_the_engine: two songs at different tempos never overlap; hand over on a beat of the outgoing song; frame moves that swap layouts are one matched move

revision_6.his_words: Sees it needs to fade in much more slowly. (Krish, 2026-11-09)
revision_6.plan: Seize It starts from silence on the beat where the cat song ends and rises over about 6 s, never overlapping the cat song
